summary:
Turn 95 recorded the run's completion state so no further turn produces adjacent handoffs or re-runs explained work on exhausted capacities.

Where the run stands. Every file in the analysis roots has been read, the map is current at version 21, and twelve claim families were established with executed artifacts: nine confirmed violations or consequences — C1 (a recovery ignores a reply reporting the instance COMMITTED and commits a NOOP vector, on a driven proposal/commit history), C3 (the same divergence reaching the applied state on that history), C2 (the durable record loses the bal value), C4 (a legal NOOP commit terminates a restarted owner, on a constructed history), C6 (the promoted-leader variant), C7 (the unreachable accept-rejection branch), C9 (the recorder writes the wrong row's metadata), C10 (a value beyond the 16-bit length field is truncated, displaces the following commands and panics the receiver's decoder), C11 (replica construction dereferences a failed probe dial), C12 (the documented transitive-conflict skipping is inert) — plus two bounded no-violation protections: C5 (the owner that survives a NOOP recovery re-proposes the operation, and its end-to-end client reply was executed as 6baf5b7715294d88a8f4a36e085ebd04) and C8 (the executor timeout enqueues a blocked instance and the enqueued entry starts a real recovery). The last item that had been inference-only is now observed by exploration (5b9267ea51d742f9a6fdcfb7a6594990): a displaced stream makes the verbose-configured peer reader exit, and without verbosity it silently clears the peer's liveness.

What remains, and why it does not need another handoff. Two items are capacity-limited rather than unknown: the end-to-end client-reply artifact needs one semantic review to be confirmed, and the reader observation needs a claim plus an artifact that observes the exit through a controlled expectation, which needs unit and review capacity. The rest are scoped questions rather than work: two paused candidates with resume conditions (accept-status semantics, client retry), the deployment premises that decide whether the latency, durable and transitive-skip paths are active, and the attribution issue on the superseded C1 artifact, which has no mechanism the validator accepts and stays visible as bookkeeping with its substance already recorded in the amended claim and in C3. No requirement, premise or earlier observation was weakened, and the run can end naturally from here.
